title: FAA UAP reports, batch 20 (237UAP00535 - 237UAP00560)
doc_notes: This document is a batch of FAA reports regarding UAP sightings by commercial and private pilots; only two reports describe objects with physical characteristics (metallic/silver) rather than just lights.

encounters.summary: Pilot reported a silver UAP 500 feet below their aircraft while in flight.
encounters.quote: REPORTED A SILVER UAP 500 FEET BELOW THE ACFT

encounters.summary: Pilot reported a metallic object while in flight.
encounters.quote: REPORTED AN UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENON OF A METALLIC OBJECT
